Container.Name: Pullarr
Container.Overview: Manage comic metadata, monitoring and Wanted acquisition, Reading Orders, quality profiles and verified upgrades. Browse GetComics Discover; use SABnzbd, NZBGet or qBittorrent with Prowlarr or Torznab. Reviewed archive maintenance preserves page bytes. Configure authentication before exposing beyond your trusted network.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: comic comics manga arr library downloader organizer reading
Container.Requires: Linux x86_64. Persistent appdata and access to client downloads. A common data mount and compatible underlying filesystem are required for hardlinks; safe copy fallback is supported.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Pullarr WebUI. Enable authentication before LAN access; never expose directly to the Internet.

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: Persistent database and settings. Back up before upgrades.

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Persistent application logs; treat as private.

Config.Name: Pullarr temporary downloads
Config.Description: Pullarr-controlled acquisition workspace. Not the external download client's completed-data path.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Common parent containing library and client downloads, e.g. media/comics and downloads/torrents. Use the same /data layout in clients; hardlinks also require compatible underlying storage.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID controlling container-created file ownership. Pre-authorize this UID on your data share.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone used by container processes, e.g. Etc/UTC.
